title: Telangana groundwater portal reportedly shows OnlyFans references and redirects to an adult page
date_note: The Pioneer's article of 26 November says the incident happened on Thursday (26 November); the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: Telangana state government department; the article does not name a city for the department
summary: The Pioneer reports that the website of Telangana's Ground Water Regulation and Management System (TG-GWRMS) reportedly showed OnlyFans references and redirected visitors to an adult-content page. An assistant commissioner at the Hyderabad Cyber Crime Police Station told The Pioneer that police had not received any official complaint from the Ground Water Department. The article carries no statement from the department.
plain: The Pioneer reports that a Telangana government groundwater portal reportedly showed adult-site references. Police told the paper they had received no official complaint from the department.
exec: A Telangana government portal reportedly redirected visitors to an adult page; the department has not been quoted and police say no complaint was filed.

validation.note: Only The Pioneer was read; no statement from the department, and a search found no second publisher.

review.note: title, claim wording, police statement, no department statement, date against The Pioneer
